quotes.text: This is the uncomfortable truth. Enterprises don't fail because systems can't connect. They fail because intent can't survive handoffs.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes integration failures as lost intent between handoffs rather than missing connectivity.

quotes.text: MCP doesn't make the model smarter. It makes the model less creative in the places where creativity is a liability.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the purpose of MCP in one memorable sentence.

quotes.text: Copilot decides what should happen. Logic apps ensures it happens within your compliance boundaries. If copilot makes a decision that violates policy, the execution plane should refuse.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the core two-plane split between reasoning and execution.

quotes.text: The counter-intuitive part is that governance isn't a policy document. Governance is what you expose. And if you expose a tool that can write to ten tables, you've already lost the argument that you control the system.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes tool design the unit of AI governance with a concrete example.

quotes.text: You don't govern agent behavior by reviewing every conversation. You govern it by designing what actions are possible.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear, actionable principle for governing AI agents at scale.

Operating model and executive decision checklist

takeaways: Enterprises rarely fail because systems cannot connect; they fail because intent does not survive handoffs between teams, systems and vendors.

Copilot Studio should interpret intent and select tools, while Azure Logic Apps executes deterministically with retries, compensation and run history that serves as audit evidence, connected through narrow MCP tools.

Governance scales through constrained tool design, managed identities, private endpoints, DLP, environment isolation and a discoverable catalog such as Azure API Center, so teams build once and reuse everywhere.
hook: Bolting a chatbot onto broken integration handoffs makes enterprise processes non-deterministic instead of better. This episode is for architects and IT leaders and shows how Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps and the Model Context Protocol split reasoning from execution, so AI agents can act on systems of record with constrained tools and a complete audit trail.
